Configuration File Class

gxConfig reads and changes name=value configuration files.

Contents

Overview
Functions

Overview

Lines are name, the parameter ID string (= by default) and value. Lines starting with the comment character (#) are skipped, and a comment after a space at the end of a value is removed, so values such as file names can contain spaces. Lookups match whole names by default, or any name containing the text with full_name false.

gxConfig cfg("server.cfg");
cfg.Load();
int port = cfg.GetIntValue("port");
std::string dir = cfg.GetString("data_dir", "/var/lib/myapp");
cfg.ChangeConfigValue("port", 8443);        // Changes the file and the loaded values
